import numpy
import msprime
import multiprocess

indnam = ["Chimp.REF_1", "Mbuti.DG_1", "Yoruba.DG_1", "French.DG_1", "Han.DG_1", "Papuan.DG_1"]

samples = [msprime.SampleSet(num_samples=i, population=j, time=k) for i, j, k in zip( (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1), ("Chimp.REF", "Mbuti.DG", "Yoruba.DG", "French.DG", "Han.DG", "Papuan.DG"), (4000, 3000, 2000, 1000, 0, 0) )]
nhap = int(len(indnam) * 2)

demo = msprime.Demography()
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "R")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Chimp.REF")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "n1")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Mbuti.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "n2")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Yoruba.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "n3")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "French.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "n4")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Han.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Papuan.DG")
demo.add_population_split(time=5000, ancestral="R", derived=["Chimp.REF","n1"])
demo.add_population_split(time=4000, ancestral="n1", derived=["Mbuti.DG","n2"])
demo.add_population_split(time=3000, ancestral="n2", derived=["Yoruba.DG","n3"])
demo.add_population_split(time=2000, ancestral="n3", derived=["French.DG","n4"])
demo.add_population_split(time=1000, ancestral="n4", derived=["Han.DG","Papuan.DG"])
demo.sort_events()

nsnps = int(1000)

def f(i):
  ts = msprime.sim_ancestry(samples=samples, demography=demo)
  tree_sequence = msprime.sim_mutations(ts, rate=0.001, model='binary')
  if tree_sequence.genotype_matrix().shape[0] > 0:
    return (tree_sequence.genotype_matrix()[0,range(0,nhap,2)] + tree_sequence.genotype_matrix()[0,range(1,nhap,2)])
  else:
    return numpy.zeros(nhap//2, 'int')

p = multiprocess.Pool(int(min(multiprocess.cpu_count(),100)))
gt = numpy.array(p.map(f, range(nsnps)))

numpy.savetxt('{outpref}.geno', gt, '%d', '')

with open('{outpref}.snp', 'w') as f:
  for i in range(nsnps):
    bytes = f.write('rs'+str(i+1)+'\t1\t' + str(i*50/float(nsnps-1)) + '\t' + str(i*100) + '\tA\tC\n')

with open('{outpref}.ind', 'w') as f:
  for i in range(len(indnam)):
    bytes = f.write(indnam[i] + '\tU\t' + indnam[i].rstrip("1234567890").rstrip("_") + '\n')

import numpy
import math
import msprime
import multiprocess

indnam = ["Chimp.REF_1", "Mbuti.DG_1", "Yoruba.DG_1", "French.DG_1", "Han.DG_1", "Papuan.DG_1"]

samples = [msprime.SampleSet(num_samples=i, population=j, time=k) for i, j, k in zip( (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1), ("Chimp.REF", "Mbuti.DG", "Yoruba.DG", "French.DG", "Han.DG", "Papuan.DG"), (4000, 3000, 2000, 1000, 0, 0) )]
nhap = int(len(indnam) * 2)

demo = msprime.Demography()
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "R")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Chimp.REF")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "n1")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Mbuti.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "n2")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Yoruba.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "n3")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "French.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "n4")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Han.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Papuan.DG")
demo.add_population_split(time=5000, ancestral="R", derived=["Chimp.REF","n1"])
demo.add_population_split(time=4000, ancestral="n1", derived=["Mbuti.DG","n2"])
demo.add_population_split(time=3000, ancestral="n2", derived=["Yoruba.DG","n3"])
demo.add_population_split(time=2000, ancestral="n3", derived=["French.DG","n4"])
demo.add_population_split(time=1000, ancestral="n4", derived=["Han.DG","Papuan.DG"])
demo.sort_events()

r_chrom = 2e-08
r_break = math.log(2)
chrom_positions = [0, 1000]
map_positions = [0, 1000]
rates = [r_chrom]
rate_map = msprime.RateMap(position=map_positions, rate=rates)

ts = msprime.sim_ancestry(samples=samples, model=[msprime.DiscreteTimeWrightFisher(duration=25), msprime.StandardCoalescent()], demography=demo, recombination_rate=rate_map)
tree_sequence = msprime.sim_mutations(ts, rate=1.25e-08, model='binary')
hap_gt = tree_sequence.genotype_matrix()
gt = hap_gt[:, range(0,nhap,2)] + hap_gt[:, range(1,nhap,2)]
nsnps = gt.shape[0]
ts_chroms = numpy.searchsorted(numpy.array(chrom_positions[1:]), tree_sequence.tables.sites.position, side='right') + 1

numpy.savetxt('{outpref}.geno', gt, '%d', '')

with open('{outpref}.snp', 'w') as f:
  for i, j in enumerate(tree_sequence.tables.sites.position):
    chrm = int(ts_chroms[i])
    if chrm == 1:
      pos = int(j) 
    else:
      pos = int(j - chrom_positions[chrm-1])
    nsnps_chr = numpy.sum(ts_chroms == chrm)
    pos_chr = numpy.sum(ts_chroms[:i] == chrm)
    bytes = f.write('rs'+str(i+1)+'\t' + str(chrm) + '\t' + str(pos_chr*50/float(nsnps_chr-1)) + '\t' + str(pos) + '\tA\tC\n')

with open('{outpref}.ind', 'w') as f:
  for i in range(len(indnam)):
    bytes = f.write(indnam[i] + '\tU\t' + indnam[i].rstrip("1234567890").rstrip("_") + '\n')

import numpy
import msprime
import multiprocess

indnam = ["Chimp.REF_1", "Yoruba.DG_1", "Han.DG_1", "French.DG_1"]

nhap = int(len(indnam) * 2)

demo = msprime.Demography()
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "R_R_Chimp.REF")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "R_R_Chimp.REFo")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "admixa")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Chimp.REF")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "R_Chimp.REF")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "R_Chimp.REF_Yoruba.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Yoruba.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "Han.DG")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "R_Chimp.REFs")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "admix")
demo.add_population(initial_size = 1000, name = "French.DG")
demo.add_population_split(time=3000, ancestral="R_Chimp.REF", derived=["R_Chimp.REF_Yoruba.DG","R_Chimp.REFs"])
demo.add_population_split(time=2000, ancestral="R_Chimp.REF_Yoruba.DG", derived=["Yoruba.DG"])
demo.add_population_split(time=5000, ancestral="R_R_Chimp.REF", derived=["R_R_Chimp.REFo","Han.DG"])
demo.add_population_split(time=4000, ancestral="R_R_Chimp.REFo", derived=["R_Chimp.REF"])
demo.add_population_split(time=1000, ancestral="admix", derived=["French.DG"])
demo.add_population_split(time=1000, ancestral="admixa", derived=["Chimp.REF"])
demo.add_admixture(time=2000, derived="admix", ancestral=["R_Chimp.REF_Yoruba.DG","R_Chimp.REFs"], proportions=[0.5,0.5])
demo.add_admixture(time=2000, derived="admixa", ancestral=["R_Chimp.REFs","R_R_Chimp.REFo"], proportions=[0.5,0.5])
demo.sort_events()

nsnps = int(1000)

def f(i):
  ts = msprime.sim_ancestry(samples=samples, demography=demo)
  tree_sequence = msprime.sim_mutations(ts, rate=0.001, model='binary')
  if tree_sequence.genotype_matrix().shape[0] > 0:
    return (tree_sequence.genotype_matrix()[0,range(0,nhap,2)] + tree_sequence.genotype_matrix()[0,range(1,nhap,2)])
  else:
    return numpy.zeros(nhap//2, 'int')

p = multiprocess.Pool(int(min(multiprocess.cpu_count(),100)))
gt = numpy.array(p.map(f, range(nsnps)))

numpy.savetxt('{outpref}.geno', gt, '%d', '')

with open('{outpref}.snp', 'w') as f:
  for i in range(nsnps):
    bytes = f.write('rs'+str(i+1)+'\t1\t' + str(i*50/float(nsnps-1)) + '\t' + str(i*100) + '\tA\tC\n')

with open('{outpref}.ind', 'w') as f:
  for i in range(len(indnam)):
    bytes = f.write(indnam[i] + '\tU\t' + indnam[i].rstrip("1234567890").rstrip("_") + '\n')
